task: Three-way Qwen3.5-0.8B comparison on Radeon 8060S/gfx1151: hipEngine (fd009c4a7) vs llama.cpp Vulkan (pinned 1d2869c6 build 10415) vs llama.cpp HIP (a94d563ed, TheRock 7.15, newly built, fa=1)

protocol.hipengine: scripts/qwen35_08b_exact_core.py, exact shared-token fixture, 3 reps; public = greedy path incl. device sampler, core excludes sampler
protocol.llamacpp: llama-bench -fa 1 -p 512 -n 128 -r 5..10 (own token protocol); tg uses CPU-side sampling loop
protocol.memory: hipEngine owned-session tracked bytes vs llama declared device buffers (model+KV+RS+compute); scopes close but not identical whole-card peaks

notes: llama HIP decode is much slower than Vulkan on this iGPU (125.2/117.1 vs 198.4/162.9)
hipEngine public decode is at parity with llama HIP (0.98x Q4, 1.00x Q8)
llama HIP pp512 shows +-7-9% run variance (clock ramp); Vulkan rows are tighter
hipEngine Q8 uses 23% less device memory than either llama backend (native-quant residents vs expanded layouts drive the llama compute-buffer parity at Q4)
